decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt is a flagship extension of an established biodynamic range that runs on existing lines at little cost to keep, and nothing so far signals failure, so the option stays open and may merit further commitment.

The mild sliced cheese is a cheap, close extension of in-house cheesemaking with its own product page, and after only one year its value is still uncertain, so keeping the option open is preferable to abandoning it.

The sliced butter cheese uses existing cheesemaking and slicing capacity at low cost to keep, and its prospects have not yet resolved after one year, so it is kept open alongside the firm's broad portfolio.
